title: Conjecture 2.7 — (see [220, Problem 1.89 (B)]) For any oriented knot K, no Vassiliev invariants distinguish K from −K.
exact_target: Can any finite-type knot invariant detect reversal of the knot orientation?

sources.citation: ULAM. AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 10400029 (AMR-103-0029). CC BY 4.0.
